Not reached. Europe PMC fullTextXML for PMC10867017 returned the complete structured deposit on the first tier (HTTP 200, 6445 bytes), and pmc_pow_fetch.py returned the publisher PDF. The cascade this skill runs was unnecessary.

R4 THRESHOLD CHECK RUN MECHANICALLY, AND THE NON-TRIGGER IS RECORDED SO IT IS AUDITABLE. All 18 claims whose Status is `consolidated baseline` were enumerated from claim_registry_current.md and their titles read: every one is WWOX-DEE neurobiology, variant interpretation or prenatal cortical structure. None concerns osteosarcoma, bone, RUNX2, NF-kB or an oncology model. ONE IS MYC-ADJACENT AND IS NAMED RATHER THAN PASSED OVER: CLAIM 007 ('P47T abolishes PPxY binding to WW-domain partners') carries Pathway `P3 - MYC/Wnt / interaction logic`. This source still does not touch it: a one-page author-name correction establishes nothing about PPxY binding, WW-domain occupancy or MYC level, and carries no measurement of any kind. The reading therefore neither narrows, reverses, corroborates nor removes any consolidated baseline claim, and justifies no working-model bump. R4 does not trigger.

A correction notice correcting an author's name contributes no measurement, no molecule, no pathway and no endpoint. There is nothing to squeeze. The one discovery-ledger consequence of this reading is a corroboration of an EXISTING entry (DL-METH-079), written as a commit candidate rather than as a new lead.
No molecule, dose, target or endpoint in the source. Transfer verdict is ESPANSIONE/T3.
No molecule is promoted or even named by this source.
Reading order for this wave was fixed by the dispatch; a two-PMID wave has no ordering question to answer.

group_assessment.weighting: ARTICLE TYPE IS A PUBLISHED ERRATUM; research_type classifies the GROUP, not this one-page notice. Akkawi, Hidmi, Haj-Yahia, Monin, Diment, Drier, Stein and Aqeilan - the Aqeilan laboratory, primary for the GENE and NOT primary for WWOX-DEE clinical phenotype. THE DISTINCTION DOES ALMOST NO WORK HERE AND THAT IS ITSELF THE POINT: the only assertions this deposit makes are about its own authorship and about what was changed in its own earlier article. Those are first-hand facts a publisher and an author group are the authoritative source for, and they carry full weight. Nothing in this source is a bone observation, so there is no observation-to-interpretation step to discount. COUNTS RE-DERIVED TODAY rather than carried: PubMed ESearch 2026-09-09, 'Aqeilan RI[Author]' = 137, 'Aqeilan RI[Author] AND WWOX' = 65. The wave-1 self-evaluation of this actor recorded 137/64 as a stale number carried from a 2026-08-11 measurement; re-derivation moves publications_on_gene 64 -> 65 and pays that declared debt.

corpus_crossquery.query: Does the corrected scope of this erratum intersect any verbatim locator standing on PMID 38182577, and does the correction alter the title on which DL-METH-079 rests?
corpus_crossquery.note: Five surfaces answered. (1) deepdive_manifests/PMID38182577.json - 30 locators, 19 figure and 11 body; every anchor names a Results/Discussion paragraph, a figure caption or a figure panel, and NOT ONE names the byline, the author list or the title, so no locator can sit inside this erratum's corrected scope. (2) fulltext_read_receipts.jsonl - FTR-20260810-38182577-01/-02 both assert that this erratum 'corrects a single author name' and 'does NOT correct the title'; that assertion belonged to a prior reader and is now re-established from this deposit and from the corrected original deposit. (3) discovery_ledger_current.md DL-METH-079 rests on the published title of 38182577 still reading 'WWOX promotes osteosarcoma development via upregulation of Myc'; re-fetch of PMC10770339 on 2026-09-09 confirms the title is unchanged post-correction, so DL-METH-079 stands. (4) erratum_scope_check.py reports PMID 38182577 as SCOPE_UNDECLARED - the structural gap this reading resolves the content of. (5) claim_registry_current.md - all 18 consolidated baseline claims enumerated for the R4 threshold check.

retraction_check.route: PubMed efetch for PMID 38355659 and Europe PMC resultType=core for PMC10867017
retraction_check.result: CLEAN, and the check is asked in both directions because this source IS a correction. (a) OF this notice: PubMed carries exactly one CommentsCorrections element, RefType=ErratumFor, pointing at Cell Death Dis 2024;15(1):13 = PMID 38182577; PublicationType is 'Published Erratum'; Europe PMC custom-meta is-retracted = no. Nothing corrects or retracts the correction. (b) BY this notice, established from the deposit rather than from any prior reader's assertion: the corrected scope is the third author's name and nothing else - 'Ameen Haji Yehya' to 'Ameen Haj-Yahia'. It corrects no datum, no figure, no panel, no table and no conclusion, and it does NOT correct the title. The notice's own byline already prints the corrected form.
retraction_check.corrected_items_basis: DECLARED EMPTY, AND THE EMPTINESS IS A MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN A DEFAULT. The erratum names no figure and no panel anywhere on either surface: its entire body is four paragraphs, quoted in full in the locators below, and the rendered page carries no figure, no table, no abstract and no reference list. An empty corrected_items is therefore the true scope, not an undeclared one - it says the erratum touches no panel, which is a different statement from 'nobody looked'.

page_renders.rule: Rule 5e - the derivation is published, never the derived image. A reader with their own copy of the PDF regenerates identical bytes.

figure_extractions.rule: ZERO FIGURES PRESENT, ZERO INSPECTED - 0/0, and the denominator was established by reading the rendered page rather than by counting figure citations in the text. Europe PMC hasSuppl=N corroborates the absence of a supplement independently, and the deposit carries no <fig> element. This is `not_present`, which is a fact about the document, and NOT `captions_only`, which would be a fact about the reading. The page image is inspected as pixels all the same, and carries two visual attestations below - a correction notice's figure count being zero does not excuse looking at it.
